rationale: Jessie brings hands-on hardware testing expertise from Sesame AI's robotics systems, while Justin is founding Strong Robotics Lab and brings full-stack development skills (TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Java). They're both operating in robotics but from complementary angles—hardware validation and software implementation—making them natural collaborators for exploring technical challenges at the intersection of their domains.
intro_message: Jessie Fan, meet Justin Strong — you're both deep in robotics and could benefit from each other's perspective on hardware-software integration for robotics systems.
